desc: Derive the potential characterization: shortest distance at least \(D\) is equivalent to labels satisfying \(x_v\le x_u+1\), \(x_1=0\), \(x_N\ge D\), with every increasing edge selected.
Develop the multilabel minimum-cut formulation using threshold variables and ensure each original edge is charged once despite multiple levels.
Prove monotonicity in \(D\) and that selecting additional edges to reach exactly \(K\) cannot decrease the shortest-path distance.
Determine bounds \(0\le D\le N-1\) and assess flow-network complexity for the constraints.
Implement the min-cut feasibility solver, binary search, and complete stdin/stdout solution; verify against all supplied samples and edge cases.
